notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.30.5 (341589)
notes.notes:
Greetings, Adventurers! In our latest update, see what’s in store for the rest of Season of The Two Embers - Part 1, then celebrate and relax in turn with Days of Sunlight and Days of Moonlight. Plus, an all-new Radiance Event, updates to dye gathering, and more are coming your way too! 



Season of The Two Embers - Part 1 Continues
There’s plenty to still explore in the Season! Once you complete the fifth Seasonal Quest, new activities and mini-games become available in the season area. Chapters from the film can be rewatched at any time via meditation pads in the Cinema.

[p align="justify"]A new themed memento will become available later in September: the Projector of Memories. This prop allows the owner and nearby players to watch the four chapters of Part 1 of Sky: The Two Embers, plus a creator commentary, on a projector screen in any of the realms. Stay tuned for details about its release date!



[p align="justify"]The Projector of Memories video plays on a scheduled loop that includes Sky: The Two Embers - Part 1, the creator commentary, and concept art showcase. Playback repeats every 80 minutes starting at 00:00 (all times PDT, UTC -7).



[p align="justify"]❗Please note that the Projector of Memories prop uses the same video playback tech as the Cinema, which means that it has same platform technical limitations on certain devices. This means that Projector of Memories video playback will not display on Nintendo Switch, Android 8, and Harmony OS on Huawei. 



[p align="justify"]Players on all devices will be able to see the prop itself and its glow effects. However, players on a platform that doesn’t support video playback will see a hint that says “This experience may be limited on your device” when standing near the prop and will not see any video projection. We apologize for any inconvenience these limitations may cause.



[p align="justify"]This and other special themed items introduced in the 0.30.0 update will continue to be available in the in-game store until the Season ends on 23:59 October 5th.

Days of Sunlight[p align="justify"]Quests, cameras, and curious spirits await you for an all-new Days of Sunlight! From September 1st through 21st, help a busy group of spirits catalogue the great outdoors, and you may find some delightful surprises along the way.



[p align="justify"]Talk to the spirits in the event area to take on special event quests each day. Venture forth into the realms to find what they seek to add to their collection and earn Event Tickets in return!



[p align="justify"]Collect up to five Event Tickets each day from event quests and the event area. You can also gather 15 bonus Tickets through special photo quests.



[p align="justify"]New cosmetics arriving with this year’s event include:
[p align="justify"]Sunlight Shawl: 22 Tickets
[p align="justify"]Sunlight Wave Projector: 45 Tickets
[p align="justify"]Sunlight Bonnet Bundle: $14.99 (all prices USD)
[p align="justify"]Includes a sun dress outfit and jellyfish-inspired hat
[p align="justify"]Sandcastle Pieces: 5-8 Candles each
[p align="justify"]Each of these seven different sandcastle pieces can be unlocked to build a sandcastle of your own design. Up to eight copies of each piece can be unlocked and then placed at once.



[p align="justify"]Days of Summer items from previous years will be back (with the exception of the Bunny Accessory and Lantern Pack, which will be in Days of Moonlight), and items introduced for Event Tickets last year can be unlocked this year with Candles. Keep an eye out for trial spells for outfit items, too!


Days of Moonlight[p align="justify"]A silver moon rises over a serene landscape, calling Sky kids to share peaceful moments, memorable riddles, and perhaps even some…transformative moments.



[p align="justify"]From September 29th through October 12th, follow the event guide Spirit to a starry-skied version of the Crescent Oasis. There you can share riddles with other players and try your hand at answering a few of your own. A nearby table will have snacks for you as well, which might just add a surprising twist to the Days of Moonlight experience.



[p align="justify"]Collect up to five Event Tickets each day by reading riddles others have shared and gathering Event Ticket Light in the area. Up to 15 bonus Event Tickets are placed around the event space, too!



[p align="justify"]This year’s news Days of Moonlight items are:
[p align="justify"]Moonlight Banner:  18 Tickets
[p align="justify"]Four of these banners are unlocked with 18 tickets. Four additional banners can be unlocked for five Candles each.
[p align="justify"]Moonlight Tufted Tail Accessory: 42 Tickets
[p align="justify"]Moonlight Basin: 75 Candles
[p align="justify"]Moonlight Garland Cape: $14.99



[p align="justify"]Days of Moonlight items from previous years will be back, plus a few items originally introduced in other events: The Bunny Accessory and Lantern Pack from Days of Sunlight as well as the Bunny Slippers from Days of Style are permanently joining the Days of Moonlight lineup. Items offered for Event Tickets last year can be unlocked this year with regular Candles.


Radiance Event[p align="justify"]A new type of event blooms in the realms! From October 13th through 26th, you’ll find that the Colored Dark Plants provide two types of Colored Light more frequently than normal, and across all realms, not just the realms their respective colors typically show up in—which will make it easier to stock up on those dyes more quickly!

More Updates[p align="justify"]We’ve made a number of other changes and improvements based on player feedback. These include:
[p align="justify"] 
[p align="justify"]A new counter has opened in the Dye Workshop in Aviary Village! If you have at least started the first Season of Radiance quest, this counter will open for you to exchange a certain amount of dye each week in exchange for a different color of dye (or even a Candle).


[p align="justify"]There are some updates to how Colored Light is gathered, too:
[p align="justify"]Calling (shouting) no longer affects vines.
[p align="justify"]Vines can be burned from any point, but burn faster from the tips.
[p align="justify"]The animation to gather the butterflies begins and ends more quickly.
[p align="justify"]When tapping the prompt to collect the butterflies that emerge from the plants, the butterflies fly towards you faster and will continue to move towards you from longer distances, even after you’re no longer in the “collection” pose.
[p align="justify"]Once any single butterfly is called towards you, the rest will follow.
[p align="justify"]Butterflies on your hand provide a small call as visual feedback and will recharge your energy.


A new option in the Settings menu allows you to toggle off the game UI while recording video. If this toggle is enabled, you can then choose whether to display chat UI as well. (There are a handful of UI elements that will still be visible, such as text for hide and seek and the spell meter; these last few stragglers will be hidden by this feature in a future update.)


The in-game calendar has some new details: The daily timeline now displays the month, and calendar information now includes event duration. Plus, when selecting the map preview on the event image, the location for the event will be highlighted. A Thai translation is available too!

[p align="justify"]You may notice a new option in the Account Info section of the Settings menu called Outfit QR Code. This is related to long-term plans to offer interactive avatar displays at real-world Sky events, so you may find this useful if you attend future Sky events in your area.


Improvements and Bug Fixes in this update include:[p align="justify"]Items with a ✶ symbol next to it means that this is a fix for something that the player community reported to us. So thank you for letting us know about the bugs you’ve come across!


[p align="justify"]Season of The Two Embers - Part 1
[p align="justify"]★ Fixed a bug causing soft-locks during the third Seasonal Quest.
[p align="justify"]Fixed an issue that allowed part of the third Seasonal Quest sequence to be skippable.
[p align="justify"]Fixed pathing issue with one of the guards during the third Seasonal Quest.
[p align="justify"]★ Fixed issues related to multiplayer networking in the fourth Seasonal Quest.
[p align="justify"]Scarred Sentry won’t run through the camera during the cutscene for the fourth Seasonal Quest.
[p align="justify"]Manatee will appear as intended when teleporting to join a friend in the seasonal area.
[p align="justify"]NPCs in the seasonal area won’t get stuck at and then teleport through obstacles.


[p align="justify"]Gameplay
[p align="justify"]★ Fixed a bug preventing players in carry mode from collecting colored Light when in a chain of players.
[p align="justify"]★ Mellow Musician was very focused on playing only one music sheet in Harmony Hall, but realized they should probably expand their repertoire—so now they’ll once again play along if a player selects a different music sheet to play together.
[p align="justify"]★ Resolved an issue preventing players from receiving a Candle for reliving base game Spirits for the first time.
[p align="justify"]★ Fixed a crash that could softlock players during the second Season of Revival Quest.
[p align="justify"]Resolved an issue preventing Jam Station patterns from saving in Shared Spaces.


[p align="justify"]Cosmetics

★ Anniversary Popcorn and Clapboard prop won’t play the unequip animations when taking out either of these props while performing an emote.
[p align="justify"]★ Fixed a bug that reduced the number of certain props that could be placed in a player’s Nest if they were purchased in the Nesting Workshop.
[p align="justify"]Fixed a number of hats that had clipping issues when equipped with the bald hairstyle.

[p align="justify"]General Fixes and Improvements
[p align="justify"]★ Fixed a bug that could cause uncollected motes of Light to become invisible to some players.
[p align="justify"]★ Fixed the delay between the end of a cutscene and being able to light a Spirit husk when reliving a Spirit’s memory.
[p align="justify"]★ Arrows to view multiple realm constellations in the Constellation pad won’t be displayed for new players who haven’t played those realms yet.
[p align="justify"]Restored a missing polygon under the stone steps leading to the jump off point from the Daylight Prairie social space.
[p align="justify"]★ \[Android] For devices set to Japanese, all text displays properly when viewing the in-game description for the Season Pass.
[p align="justify"]There was a huge party in Aviary, and the rock couldn't get enough! They attended every single event on the blue stage, and were inspired by all the different Sky kids who joined in to ask questions and talk about their experiences. Stories of friendship, hopes for the future, and silly moments all brought joy to the little stone. Maybe one day the rock would have their moment in the spotlight, too! They could tell everyone how amazing jellyfish are! In the wise words of a Sky kid in a stacked tophat, the rock wanted to be faumous! 



[p align="justify"]Please refer to this page for known issues ongoing or introduced with this patch: Known Issues Patch 0.30.5.

[p align="justify"]As always, we look forward to hearing your feedback, and encourage you to join the community discussion on our official Discord server at discord.gg/thatskygame!

Greetings, Adventurers! We have a hotfix!

Changes in this update include:


Anniversary

Fixed a bug preventing players from exiting the Cinema View if the Festival Tech reaction menu was not collapsed or minimized.

Updates to AFK timer while Cinema View: To optimize video performance for all players, after a player in Cinema View is inactive for 40 minutes the movie screen will finish playing the current video, then end further video playback until the player’s avatar becomes active again.



Season of The Two Embers

Improvements to various visual and animation errors in the seasonal area, including scenery flickering in and out around the Tender Toymaker’s stand and NPC jittery walking animations during cutscenes for Seasonal Quests.

Fixed framerate drop during cutscenes for the second Seasonal Quest.

Token won’t sink into the ground during Seasonal Quests.

Fixes for bugs that could result in blocked progress in Seasonal Quests.

Ending cutscene in the second Seasonal Quest now includes avatars of all heights in the camera frame.

Fix for crashes during certain level transitions affecting Android devices.

Fixes for various NPC errors in the season area.

Resolved blank icon prompt during second Seasonal Quest.

Fixed light on the map shrine in the seasonal area.

Fixed a crash that could happen when using a salute emote with a soldier during the first quest.

Removed a fixture mistakenly present in the manatee pen.

Avatar movement prevented during Seasonal Quest cutscenes, which could lead to quest progression breaks and other issues.



General Fixes and Improvements

Fixed visual shaking when motion blur is turned off.

To prevent griefing, plushies cannot be thrown out of Nest windows, which would require reloading a Nest to replace.

Fixed a bug that could softlock players who went AFK in certain situations.

Fixed missing map shrine marker for Daily Quests involving the Tranquil Garden area.

Fixed an erroneous “Game Data Corrupt” error message that could appear after tapping the emote in the Relationship Tree of the Royal Hairtousle Teen.

Renaming friends and others that a player has newly followed no longer causes server errors for that player.

Fixed a bug that prevented more than two Shared Spaces from appearing at the Shared Spaces Shrine in Aviary Village’s Nesting Workshop.

Fixes for other visual issues in the game such as floating pots in Daylight Prairie Village, outfit closet “decal” symbol clipping into the terrain, and rendering issues with the murals on the sides of walls/buildings in Aviary Village.

notes.title: Patch Notes - July 18, 2025 - 0.30.0 (334880)
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/6363974c25d4fec9f17483a23d262c067b76d6eb.jpg"]



Hello, Skyfarers! The 0.30.0 update brings you some new adventures that we know you’ve all been waiting for—plus features, improvements, and bug fixes to make your journey through the skies a little brighter.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/3275a7396c87574e72998a48119287c8cf7c1dd7.jpg"]




Season of The Two Embers - Part 1
Starting July 21st, a brand new adventure blends storytelling, gameplay, and cinema into an unforgettable experience.



The Season Guide in Aviary Village and Home will teleport you to the Cinema. This is where each Seasonal Quest becomes available as chapters of Sky’s long-awaited animation Sky: The Two Embers - Part 1, available for everyone to watch in the Cinema. 


These quests transport you deeper into the world shown in The Two Embers. Unlock cosmetics from this Season’s Spirits, each inspired by the story of The Two Embers. Two Ultimate Gifts can be unlocked, and special themed mementos and outfit items will also be available in the in-game shop while the Season is active—some appearing during the first half of the Season, and others coming in the second half!



Hair accessories:

Butterfly Blossom Memento: $2.99 (all prices USD)

Mini Manatee Accessory: $3.99 

Manatee Plush: $6.99

Spirited Manatee Ensemble: $9.99

Includes a tail and head accessory

Vestige of Dark Dragons:  $11.99

A more sinister tail and head accessory

Cloak of Darkness: $14.99


Season of The Two Embers - Part 1 runs from July 21st through October 5th (all times PDT, UTC -7).


For extra information, check out our blog post: https://bit.ly/SeasonofTheTwoEmbers


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/ddf56e63590514820c60122e0d83cc1cceaa502b.jpg"]
Sky’s Sixth Anniversary: The Main Event Arrives!
The Cinema is open and Sky Anniversary is officially in full swing! This is truly a gala event, with way too much happening to fit into the patch notes. 



So here a few sample highlights:

The Sky Creator Awards will be held LIVE in the Cinema on Friday August 15th at 18:30! The countdown video starts at 18:00, so come in early to catch some chill beats.

New weekly quests: Collect Event Tickets by watching each chapter of Sky: The Two Embers - Part 1 as they’re released.

New event items available to unlock or purchase, including a tuxedo and gown to wear to the Creator Awards in August.

Blue Carpet Interviews: Join TGC staff and special guests for a chance to be interviewed on a special mini stage in the Anniversary Aviary Village.

Cinema feature videos: Catch special videos, Creator Awards Showcases, and more on the Cinema’s silver screen.

Eye of Eden Run with the Devs: Join TGC staff as they lead (or stumble?) their way through Eye of Eden!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/e82783ec7f136c09adebca7070141e82786bdd0f.jpg"]

To see all the in-game events happening, and what time they start, be sure to check the in-game Calendar! Find it in the News section in the Settings menu. Keep an eye out for a News post with more details later on, too!



The Anniversary items that were released at the start of the event in 0.29.5 will remain available through the end of the event. (However, as mentioned in the 0.29.5 patch notes, the TGC Wireframe Cape can be purchased in the TGC Office area after the event. This cape allows the owner and anyone they’re holding hands to teleport to the Anniversary area and play its activities year-round, with the exception of access to the TGC Office and Cinema programming.)


Several new items are joining the lineup with 0.30.0 for the rest of the Anniversary:

Sky Balloon prop: 16 Event Tickets

Blue Carpet: 26 Event Tickets

Anniversary Suit: 66 Event Tickets

Balloon Arch prop: 20 Candles



These items will be available August 11th through 17th, just in time for the Creator Awards on August 15th:

Anniversary Gown Ensemble: $9.99

Includes a gown and shoes

Anniversary Tuxedo Cape: $14.99



Note for players on Switch and Android 8:

Unfortunately, due to platform technical limitations, chapters of the animation and Cinema feature videos cannot be viewed on your devices. 

To complete the new weekly quests, you’ll only need to visit the Cinema. 

To view each chapter of Sky: The Two Embers - Part 1 as well as other video content in the Cinema, we recommend using a different device that supports these features in Sky. 

New Features & More Updates

Speech to Chat

Transcribe your chat message on mobile and PC! Activate by tapping or clicking the microphone icon above the speech bubble icon in the lower left corner of your screen, or by tapping the T button on your keyboard.


Speech to Chat works for the language your device is configured to, though (much like human brains) it works best if you use just one language at a time.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/ccccc245337bb177138d900950715b245234c7a4.jpg"]

Spotlight Tech Feature: Follow and Send Gifts to Performers

After Spotlight Tech was released, we saw a lot of player feedback asking for ways to better express appreciation for the person sharing something onstage, or to be able to see more of that person’s Shared Memories and other creations. So we’ve made something that allows you to do just that! 



A new menu appears when watching performers that gives you the option to send a Heart to a performer or other on-stage player using Spotlight Tech, and to choose to “follow” them and see more of their Creations in the realms. 


More Updates

A group of Spirits from various Seasons will appear for a special visit in one of the realms from August 18th through 31st.

It now costs one Candle to send a Friend Post recorded message instead of two. (Players will need to update to 0.30.0 in order to see the new price.)

The Sky Event Calendar is now out on ALL devices that support Sky, including consoles and PC. This is accessible in the calendar tab in the News section in the Settings menu.

Another batch of new Daily Quests have been added, so keep your eye out while playing through this update!

The meditation area that was initially introduced last year as part of Sky Anniversary will remain in the game after the Sixth Anniversary event ends, accessible from the regular version of Aviary Village!

The Collaboration Room has been moved from Vault of Knowledge to Aviary Village. Specifically, the entrance to the Cinema that you restored in 0.29.5 is now the entrance to the Collaboration Room. That’s where you can access the entrances to areas featured in current and past collaboration Seasons, including the Cinema for Season of the Two Embers - Part 1. 

On a related note, the Cinema will remain permanently available to all players as part of Sky’s realms after the Season and Anniversary conclude.

When using the SkyFest Wireframe Cape or the TGC Wireframe Cape to access the Anniversary area after the event concludes, the History of Sky and Art of Sky galleries available from the Isle of Dawn and Hidden Forest portals will be available 24/7. Oreo’s Playground will also last for a full day when it is scheduled instead of a short period during the day.



Improvements and Bug Fixes in this update include:
Items with a ✶ symbol next to it means that this is a fix for something that the player community reported to us. So thank you for letting us know about the bugs you’ve come across!



Gameplay

✶ Fixed crash when meditating to begin the first Season of Assembly quest.

\[Android] Fixed a crash affecting certain Android devices, particularly those with the Adreno 740 GPU, in cases such as soon after login or summoning friends’ avatars from the Constellation. 

✶ Fixed a bug that made players can fall out of bounds when tapping the Event Calendar prompt from a distance while in Micro Mode in the Anniversary area.

✶ When entering the Anniversary area while the Spirit Parade is active, the background music for the Spirit Parade and Aviary Village no longer overlap.


General Fixes and Improvements

✶ When using the SkyFest Wireframe Cape to enter the Anniversary area on a device using a low framerate, the SkyFest guide won’t overlap with the current Event Guide.

Closed the interdimensional vortex that was apparently hidden in the seats of the Fireworks Show that could cause players to clip into the ground, float, or send them underground when they stood up.

Fixed the black transition screen that would appear but not transition to anything when interacting with the Anniversary Guide during the Pool Party activity.

An indoor light no longer shines through the walls in Aviary Village when the fireworks are about to begin.

✶ On Pool Party days, the screen won’t flash white when exiting the Friendship Menu on the Constellation Pad.

✶ Fixed icons above the Anniversary Guide overlapping when joining the event area from the Isle of Dawn Gallery or the TGC Office Party.

Enabled an ember zone around the map shrine when viewing it in the Anniversary area.

✶ Returned the water that had gone missing from behind the 4-player door in Vault of Knowledge and the first cave in Isle of Dawn.

✶ Fixed camera zooming in from afar when entering Golden Wasteland through a realm portal.

Patched some holes in the Vault of Knowledge Archives area that could easily trap unsuspecting moths, plus a hole in the floor in one of the tunnels in the Valley of Triumph.

Golden Wasteland is not the location of the legendary castle in the sky, so the bugged distant floating castle that could be seen in the Shipwreck area has been removed.

Fixed inconsistent boat color when traveling from the dock in Wasteland to the Forgotten Ark area.

In the Valley of Triumph Coliseum, fixed the distant snow and hills appearing to flicker when viewing it through the entrance to the Coliseum.

Improved implementation of language filters related to Shared Memories.

Fixed strange camera zoom sequence for players who begin the fourth quest from the Hopeful Steward and then restart the game.

Was someone planning a party? The rock noticed signs of festivity everywhere in the little village where they liked to hang out. Balloons, fireworks, birthday songs, and kids running around everywhere talking about something called a cinema where they could watch pictures move and tell stories! The rock wondered how pictures could move but was really curious about what stories would be told here. Maybe someone would tell birthday stories? Perhaps even stories about other rocks??



Please refer to this page for known issues ongoing or introduced with this patch: Known Issues Patch 0.30.0.



As always, we look forward to hearing your feedback, and encourage you to join the community discussion on our official Discord server at discord.gg/thatskygame!

notes.title: Patch Notes - April 17, 2025 - 0.29.0 (319554 Steam)
notes.notes:
A new Season comes to Sky on the wings of a fabled Blue Bird! Plus what would this time of year be without two of Sky’s most vibrant events: Days of Nature and Days of Color. And for those Sky kids out there who have wished they could fit more items into the Nest to create the most amazing room, café, sculpture, or plushie museum ever—well, this update has a new feature that can help you out.


Season of the Blue Bird
What does it take to heal a heart? Sky’s newest Season brings back a family of Spirits who are on the search for a legendary blue bird said to have the power to heal sadness. Join them as they search for this creature to lift a weight from the heart of a young child, and as you complete Seasonal Quests, you’ll gradually discover the true nature of the Blue Bird.

As you spend time with this group of Spirits, they’ll teach you new expressions, and each offers a range of items reflecting the story of the Season—capes, outfits, hats, boots, and more, plus two Ultimate Gifts!

The Season starts on April 21 (all times PDT, UTC -7) and continues through July 6th.


Days of Nature
For three weeks beginning April 28, a new form of Darkness traps Light Creatures who need your aid. Swim to set them free, and they’ll grant you Light in return for your kindness. 

Different Light creatures appear through each phase of the event—but beware, because Dark Creatures have also arrived, and they lurk beneath the waters, on the lookout for unsuspecting Sky kids!

Each day, gather Event Light to forge up to five Event Tickets per day—plus, 15 one-time bonus Tickets are hidden around the event area. These can be used to unlock two of this year’s new cosmetics: the Ocean Waves outfit and the Ocean Manta hair.

Other items include the Ocean Sea Foam Set in the in-game shop, which captures the shimmering beauty of water in both a cape and a pair of boots ($24.99). Items from previous years are returning with the tides too—the Nature Wave Mask and Nature Wave Scarf will be offered for Candles and Hearts, respectively. For details on other items, check out the patch notes from previous years!

Days of Nature has always been a time to give back. Sky continues its partnership with The Ocean Cleanup, a nonprofit organization dedicated to ridding the world’s oceans and rivers of plastic pollution. This year the event will again offer special IAPs to support charity efforts focused on real-world cleanup work in oceans and waterways. 

Half of the total list price of items listed here will be donated to these efforts (these items are also marked in-game). The remaining amount will cover platform fees and a portion of development.

notes.title: Patch Notes - February 27, 2025 - 0.28.5 (313329 Steam)
notes.notes:
Greetings, Adventurers! Season of Radiance brings more updates as it approaches its colorful conclusion—the final Seasonal Quests, plus an expansion to dyeable items.

An adventure comes in the shape of an event: The brand new Days of Treasure beckons you to hidden rewards.

Then there’s the new Spotlight Tech feature, a Double Light Event, a special group of Spirits headed to the realms, and more—keep reading for the details!

 

Season of Radiance Continues
More colors are on their way to herald the second half of the Season! All the varieties of Colored Light become available with the remaining Seasonal Quests, and the Radiance Guide and their friends invite you to use the dyes you collect to add your own personal, and colorful, touch to your favorite items.

Once you complete all of the Seasonal Quests, the Radiance Guide offers the chance to unlock a new and uniquely shaped cape in exchange for Hearts. (This will remain available to unlock even after the Season ends on 23:59 Sunday April 6th—all times Pacific).

 

Dye-Related Updates, Too!

This update brings some improvements to how dyeing works:


 A number of hats as well as face, neck, and head accessories are dyeable now.
 The dye selection menu now has symbols associated with each color for easier use.
 Numbers were added to the dye button to correspond with the amount of dye needed to dye a region of an item.

 

Days of Treasure: Prizes Await on the Horizon
A mystical chart be showin' the path to secret loot! Sky’s newest event comes ashore from March 3rd through 16th for every adventurous Sky kid. Two teams of Spirits (who you may recognize from past Seasons) will appear in a different realm every day, each hoping that you will help them on their hunt for buried treasure. 

Teleport to the teams’ location from the guide Spirit in Aviary Village or Home, and then choose which team you’ll help that day. Take a look at their magical map for a clue for where your search will take you, borrow their shovel, and then set out on the search!

The Spirit teams are competing with each other to see which one will receive the most help from Sky kids. At the end of the event, the winning Spirit team will send a special thank you message (and reward) to all Sky kids’ inboxes, in gratitude for your support.

Gain up to five Event Tickets each day from Event Ticket Light rewarded when you discover the Treasure. There are also 15 specially shaped bonus Event Tickets that can be found throughout the event, several in each of the Days of Treasure locations.

Themed items for Days of Treasure include:


 Treasure Cavalier Boots: 30 Event Tickets
 Treasure Shovel: 30 Event Tickets
 Treasure Seeker's Bounty: $14.99 (all prices USD) - Includes an eye patch mask, outfit, and a black and white dye each
 Dye Blessing: 10 Event Tickets each (up to three blessings)

Free trial spells are available for all items—find them near the Spirits and their map in their event area!

 

New Feature: Spotlight Tech!
A new feature makes its official premier: Spotlight Tech allows players to perform in front of an audience of other Sky kids, up to nearly 300 in the same server instance!

The spotlight shines in the Aviary concert hall, where this feature lets any player join a queue for their turn to perform a brief melody on the grand concert hall piano. No auditions necessary! Just be sure that you’ve finished the second Season of Duets quest from the Duets Guide in the concert hall.

In between melodies, or if you’d rather enjoy the music others share, there are plenty of seats for you and your fellow audience members to take it all in together.

Over the years, we’ve seen just how many memories players have created by sharing music with each other on instruments, from intricate arrangements to simple but heartfelt songs. We’re excited to see the performances you come up with!

 

Daylight Saving Time
Daylight Saving Time takes effect at 2:00 am Pacific Time on Sunday March 9th, moving clocks ahead an hour. Time notation for events in Sky will change from UTC -8 to UTC -7. If your region does not observe this time change, after March 10th daily reset will occur an hour earlier for you.

Note that due to technical limitations affecting the servers, after reset on March 10th, clusters of Season Candles and Treasure Candles from March 9th will remain in their level for one additional hour, while the clusters of Season and Treasure Candles for the 10th spawn in their respective level. 

The total number of Season and Treasure Candles available in the game returns to normal at 1:00 am March 10th PDT. We appreciate your understanding.

 

Special Group of Visiting Spirits Arriving in April!

Six Spirits will pay Sky children a special visit in April! Mark your calendars for April 7th through 20th—and stay tuned for more announcements as the date approaches.

 

Some More Updates to Mention

 From March 17th through 23rd, find four extra Seasonal Candle locations in the realms, and you’ll be able to gather an additional Seasonal Candle each day. There will also be double Treasure Candles scattered across two realms each day. Find all eight for a boost to your Candle run!

 Now if you add a chat message to your Emote Favorites menu, the language filter will be applied before it saves to the menu.

 If you’re reading the patch notes, you’re likely not a new player—but in case you find yourself guiding new friends through the skies, heads up that we’ve made improvements to the experience for players entering Sky for the first time. Some of these may also be visible even if you’re not new, such as:
 The Rejecting Voyager is placed outside of their now-former tunnel in Isle of Dawn, and the Constellation Gate there has been removed.
 If an emote or outfit item is still locked, hint text indicates what Spirit it’s from and how to acquire it.
 All outfits that can be unlocked can be previewed in the closet by all players.
 Updates to the Isle of Dawn cave intro sequence, including red Candle placement.

 

Improvements and Bug Fixes in this update include:
Items with a ✶ symbol next to it means that this is a fix for something that the player community reported to us. So thank you for letting us know about the bugs you’ve come across!

 

Highlights


 ✶ Fixed Colored Light butterflies being drawn away (or appearing to be drawn away) by deep calling.
 ✶ Resolved issues that could occur when using one-handed mode, such as inability to deep call, to open the Emote Favorites menu normally, or to interact with Friendship Menus.

 Outfit items you do not own can now be previewed in the color dye station.
 ✶ Fixed an issue where butterflies would sometimes appear pitch black.

 

Gameplay


 ✶ There are many wonders in Prairie Peaks, but underwater Shard Eruptions shouldn’t be one of them, so we fixed the Shard Eruption that was happening underwater in the river.

Cosmetics

 ✶ Fixed a graphics corruption when equipping the Style Wide-Leg Jeans.

General Fixes and Improvements

 Avatars won’t sometimes randomly change the direction they face when transitioning to a new area within a level.

 ✶ Holes in the wall are perfect for a spot for an incredible restaurant or cozy cafe, but not so much when it’s a place in Prairie Peaks that players can get stuck in, so we fixed that particular hole in the wall there.
 Fixed rippled water effect floating in the air in Prairie Peaks.
 Fixed odd UI behavior when interacting with the dye menu via trackpad. 
 Fixed certain cases where it was possible for a player to get stuck under a table, or under the table in the Dye Workshop.
 ✶ The Sky kid NPC in the Office has put their mask back on.
 ✶ Filled in a polygon that was missing backstage in the Village Theater area, and a hole on the mainstage itself that hapless players could easily fall through while wearing the chibi mask.
 Avatar animation won’t break when holding a fan prop and candle at the same time.
 The Sleepy Traveling Merchant’s rug no longer clips into the ground inside the Spell Shop in Aviary Village.
 Remembrance Guide's sash no longer clips with their body.
 ✶ Fixed crashes on mobile devices when using an instrument via an external keyboard.
 ✶ [Android] Mouse input won’t be registered as touch input when used on Android devices.

 [Android] Text field UI properly displays when chatting on a Galaxy Note 10+ while using a Bluetooth keyboard.

 ✶ [iOS] Images taken by the in-game screenshot on iPad will no longer be stretched or distorted when graphic settings are set to Letterbox Mode aspect ratio.

notes.notes:
Greetings, Adventurers! We’re starting 2025 with all kinds of updates for you—Season of Radiance kicks off this month, and it brings a brand new dyeing feature for you to customize cosmetics with new color designs.

Days and Fortune and Days of Love bring new twists to familiar favorites, Aviary Village has an announcement board to keep track of events (among other improvements), and there are some other updates too. 

Plus, mark your calendars for Friday the 17th—we’ll have a dress rehearsal in the Aviary Village concert hall to stress test an upcoming feature!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/d7695a0cc1cad8bb6460175e2fad7e93af52879d.jpg

Season of Radiance
A world of color awaits you! Sky’s next Season introduces a feature that many players have been requesting: dyes! The Season of Radiance Guide welcomes you to Aviary Village’s new Dye Workshop, and through Seasonal Quests they’ll teach you about colored Light that can be gathered in the realms, and how you can use it to forge dyes to customize the colors of your outfits.

Three Spirits who you may recognize from Sky’s earliest Season will return, too! These Season of Gratitude Spirits come back to share in Sky kids’ discoveries, and this time, they’re bringing three new expressions, not to mention a variety of capes, outfits, instruments and more—and just about everything can be dyed!

The Radiance Guide offers two Ultimate Gifts for Season Pass holders to unlock while the Season is active. They’ll also bring a uniquely shaped cape which can be unlocked with Hearts even after the Season ends—a memento to mark the opening of the Dye Workshop.

Season of Radiance begins January 20th and runs through April 6th (all times Pacific). Content is accessible to all players who have progressed to at least the third quest from the Hopeful Steward.


New Feature: Dyeing Cosmetics
Transform your ensemble into unique creations! Over the course of Season of Radiance, eight different base colors will become available to gather from special Dark Plants in the realms—some colors will be more common than others. Use these base colors as their own dye, or mix them to create a total of over 70 colors!

 In 0.28.0, most capes, masks, and outfits (e.g. pants, dresses, tunics) have dyeable areas; items in other categories, such as head and neck accessories, are planned to become dyeable in 0.28.5. Some cosmetics are not dyeable—for example, hair color, Season pendants, collaboration items, and so on.
 You can preview color combinations before dyeing a cosmetic.
 Up to two different dyed versions of an item can be saved for you to wear as “Outfit Styles,” in addition to the original version.
 Some of the seasonal spells in the Radiance Spirits’ Friendship Trees will give dye.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120852/47f3884adb6ceacb18c7674979e4b589d4ad886a.png

Days of Fortune
Let the biggest reunion party of the year begin! From January 27th through February 9th, celebrate with Spirits in the Valley of Triumph, play minigames with friends, and dance to the best dance track this side of Eye of Eden.

Talk to the Event Guide in Aviary Village or Home to teleport to the center of the action in Valley of Triumph. That’s where you’ll find a new minigame waiting for you in the ice rink. You’ll also find some familiar Spirits joining in the celebration there, so be sure to say hello!

A felicitous dragon friend returns to share Light, and they’ll be floating in the air for you regardless of what time you visit them. You’ll be able to transform into a dragon chain with fellow Sky kids once again, and yes, the Secret Area accessible from the ground floor of Vault of Knowledge will be open to all. 

The Fortune Gift Envelope will be back as well. This will be in the Friendship Trees of friends with whom you’ve unlocked the carry (piggyback) interaction and allows you to use 14 Candles to gift 5 Hearts. The Fortune Gift Envelope can be given once a day per person, like regular Heart gifts.

(Note: The Fortune Gift Envelope feature requires manual enabling, which means it will become available at approximately 00:00 on the day the event begins until approximately 23:59 the day it ends. Thank you for your understanding!)

Five coin-shaped Event Tickets (previously referred to as event currency) can be forged each day by playing the new minigame. There are also 15 one-time bonus Tickets that can be gathered throughout the event!
